references.text: The Lord's anger burned against Israel, and he gave them into the hands of raiders who plundered them, and he sold them into the hands of enemies all around
The Lord's anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan-Rishathaim
The Lord sold Israel into the hand of Jabin, king of Canaan, as another example of God's wrath and judgment over Israel's sin
Samuel reminds Israel that they forgot the Lord, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines and other enemies
The Lord's anger burned against his people, and he gave them into the hand of the nations as a result of their sin
Israel did what was evil in the Lord's sight, and the Lord gave them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years
Moses' song describes how the Lord sold his people and handed them over to the enemy because of their unfaithfulness
The Lord declares that Israel was sold because of their sins and wrongdoing
